create.name: Annemaree Rowley
create.bio:
Annemaree Rowley is a yoga and meditation teacher based in Melbourne, where she has run her practice, Cool, Calm & Collected, for more than fifteen years. She first trained in the 1980s with the Sivananda yoga schools in Europe and India and has kept studying ever since, more recently in Shanti Yoga with Shanti Gowans. Before teaching full time she worked at executive level in the corporate world, which shapes her down-to-earth way of helping busy people slow down.

She teaches classical Hatha, Yin and Restorative yoga, along with mindfulness, meditation and yoga nidra, which closes every one of her classes. Her emphasis falls on easy, unhurried breathing, steadiness of mind and kindness towards oneself, and her classes welcome complete beginners and people of every age. She holds weekly classes at Happy Melon studio in Armadale, which can also be joined on Zoom, gives private lessons and online sessions, and has led small-group yoga tours and retreats in India, Vietnam and elsewhere. Her Insight Timer meditations and two ten-part Pathway to Peace courses explore one quality at a time, such as patience, letting go or silence.

courses.title: Hatha and Yin Yoga Classes (Armadale and Zoom)
courses.description: Weekly classical Hatha, Yin and meditation classes at Happy Melon studio in Armadale, Melbourne, most of which can also be joined live on Zoom. Every class ends with a period of yoga nidra; beginners are welcome.

courses.title: Private Yoga Lessons
courses.description: One-to-one yoga sessions shaped around the student, held at a studio or in the student's home in Melbourne. Suited to newcomers, people wanting to deepen their practice, or those who prefer individual attention.

courses.title: Online Hatha Yoga
courses.description: Audio recordings of her 75-minute Zoom Hatha classes, each with breathing practice, postures, meditation and final relaxation. Access is given by password on request, so students can practise with her at any time.

courses.title: The Pathway to Peace – Series 1
courses.description: A downloadable set of ten short audio lessons, best taken over ten days, each reflecting on a quality such as kindness. About two hours in total.

courses.title: Mindfulness Recordings: The Qualities of Humanity
courses.description: Single downloadable practices (Being, Patience, Be Silent, Let Go and Open Palms), each centred on one humane quality to notice and cultivate in yourself.

courses.title: Śāntimarga – Path to Peace, Volume 1 (CD)
courses.description: A four-track CD of guided deep relaxation and yoga nidra in her voice, posted from Melbourne. Postage is added to the price.

courses.title: Paving Your Pathway To Peace
courses.description: A ten-day Insight Timer course in which each lesson takes up one theme, such as acceptance, patience, silence or joy, and how it plays out in body, mind and spirit.
courses.price: Included in Member Plus ($59.99 USD a year)

courses.title: Paving Your Pathway To Peace (Part 2)
courses.description: The ten-day sequel on Insight Timer, looking at self-respect, inner dialogue, deep listening, personal values and friendship, one theme a day.
courses.price: Included in Member Plus ($59.99 USD a year)

free_resources.title: Annemaree Rowley on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Gentle guided meditations, breathing practices and yoga nidra relaxations, many built around a single quality like patience or kindness. All can be played free in the app or online.

free_resources.title: Cool, Calm & Collected Podcast
free_resources.description: Her free podcast of spoken mindfulness and relaxation practices, also on Spotify.
